channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Journalism & Writers, NL, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Journalism & Writers, NL, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Fonds BJP Press Play 2027: Development Programme for Journalistic Makers (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Fonds BJP (Fonds voor Bijzondere Journalistieke Projecten)
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 3,200 towards about 20 days of time invested, plus a personal coach and workshops. No application fee.

Press Play helps makers develop and pitch a journalistic or creative project, with five places in each of four tracks: audio, video, writing and photo.

Apply on the organiser's site
